title: McShann's Army service
summary: They discuss McShann's flat feet and his work in Special Services playing for officers.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: Because MacShann didn't get to go into any bands or anything, did he?
Not that I know of, but he was there --
Special services. I don't even see why they took MacShann because he had such flat feet.
His feet really gave him trouble.
He said, when the doctors -- after he'd been in about nine months and the doctors told him, they said, 'My God, how did they ever take you?'
But he said that they never probably would have taken him if he hadn't been followed all over with that call and they got mad at him, and would take him if he was half dead.
Well, you know how the Army is.
He played for all the officers and things like that.
